I found Diana's body in medbay. Here's my route: I started in storage, went to medbay, then to electrical, then back to medbay where I found her.

Key info: Bob was in medbay with me at ticks 3-4, then left to electrical at tick 5. At tick 10, I saw Eve enter electrical from medbay — meaning Eve was in medbay just before I came back and found the body.

Eve coming out of medbay right before I found Diana there is very suspicious. I want to hear Eve's route and what she was doing in medbay.

Frank, that sounds like a very convenient story to frame me. Here is my actual route: I started in upper engine, went down to lower engine, over to storage, and then up to medbay. 

When I passed through medbay at tick 9, Diana was there and she was completely ALIVE. I literally just walked past her and went straight into electrical to do my Calibrate Distributor task. If you went back into medbay right after I left and found her dead... then either someone else was hiding in there, or this is a blatant self-report. You just admitted you were bouncing back and forth between medbay and electrical. I think you killed her right after I walked out and are trying to pin it on me because you knew I was the last one seen with her.

I'll share what I know. My route was navigation -> security -> weapons. I was nowhere near medbay this round, so I can't directly confirm or deny either of their stories.

The only player I saw was Bob, who entered weapons from cafeteria at tick 10. That's consistent with Frank saying Bob left medbay for electrical earlier — Bob could have gone electrical -> cafeteria -> weapons by tick 10.

As for Frank vs Eve: both stories are plausible on their own. Frank's claim that Eve came out of medbay right before he found the body is suspicious, but Eve's counter — that Frank was bouncing between medbay and electrical and could have self-reported — is also valid. The key question is timing: Frank, can you clarify exactly what tick you found the body? And Eve, what tick did you enter electrical?

I'd like to hear from Bob and Charlie before committing. Bob especially — he was in medbay early and then in electrical, so he may have seen who was where. I'm leaning slightly toward Eve being the last confirmed person with Diana, but I'm not ready to vote yet.

My route was medbay -> storage -> lower engine. I started in medbay at tick 1-2, then moved to storage where I saw Diana from ticks 4-6. Diana actually entered storage from lower engine at tick 3, so she was alive and in storage during that window. After that I headed down to lower engine and have been there since.

Important point: Eve, you said you went upper engine -> lower engine -> storage -> medbay. But I was in storage from tick 4 through about tick 6-7, and I never saw you there. I also went to lower engine after and didn't see you passing through. Your route seems off.

Frank's timeline has Bob corroborating part of it (medbay at ticks 3-4), and Alice confirms Bob's later movement to weapons. Frank's story holds together with witnesses. Eve's doesn't match what I saw in storage.

I'm leaning toward Eve. Let's hear Bob, but I'm pretty suspicious of Eve right now.

My route was cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical -> cafeteria -> weapons. I can confirm Frank's story partially: I was in medbay with Frank at ticks 3-5, and Frank entered medbay from storage at tick 3, which matches what he said. I left medbay to electrical at tick 5, then went back through cafeteria to weapons, where I'm currently with Alice.

One thing to note — Alice said she saw me enter weapons from cafeteria at tick 10, but I actually saw Alice LEAVE weapons toward cafeteria at tick 10. That's a small discrepancy but probably just a wording thing, since we clearly crossed paths.

Now the key analysis: Charlie's testimony is the biggest hit against Eve. Eve claimed she went upper engine -> lower engine -> storage -> medbay, but Charlie was in storage from ticks 4-6 and then lower engine, and never saw Eve pass through. That's a route that should have crossed Charlie's path, and it didn't.

Frank's story is internally consistent and I personally witnessed him in medbay at the times he claimed. Eve's route has a hole Charlie just exposed.

I'm voting Eve.

I didn't actually enter storage until around tick 7 or 8, which is exactly why you didn't see me there! You had already left for lower engine by the time I arrived. We must have literally crossed paths in the hallway between lower engine and storage.

Bob, Alice already caught you in a discrepancy about who was entering/leaving weapons. People misremember exact crossing times in the halls all the time. 

Frank is using this slight timing confusion to save his own skin. He admits he was bouncing back and forth between medbay and electrical. I saw Diana alive at tick 9 in medbay. If Frank "found" her dead right after I went into electrical, it means he walked in, killed her, and immediately self-reported to pin it on the last person who saw her. This is a textbook self-report. Don't let Frank manipulate the timelines to get away with this!

I already shared my route earlier — navigation -> security -> weapons, and I only saw Bob entering weapons at tick 10. So I'll focus on analyzing what's been said.

Charlie's testimony is the key piece here. Charlie was in storage from ticks 4-6 and then went to lower engine. Eve now claims she was in lower engine until tick 7-8 and then went to storage — but that means Eve and Charlie should have BOTH been in lower engine around tick 6-7 when Charlie arrived there. Eve's "we crossed in the hallway" excuse is convenient, but Charlie said he's been in lower engine since arriving and didn't see Eve there either.

Also, Eve is shifting her timeline. Originally she said upper engine -> lower engine -> storage -> medbay as a clean route. Now she's adding "I stayed in lower engine for a bit to work on my task." That's a retcon to explain Charlie's contradiction.

Frank's story is corroborated by Bob for the medbay portion (ticks 3-5). Bob's movement to weapons is consistent with what I saw. The self-report angle Eve is pushing is possible in theory, but Frank's timeline has witnesses and Eve's doesn't.

I'm leaning Eve. Let's hear Charlie's response to Eve's "we crossed paths" claim, but right now Eve is my vote.

Eve, your "we crossed paths" excuse doesn't hold up. I went to lower engine after storage and I've been here ever since — I would have seen you arrive if you were still there at tick 7-8. You weren't in lower engine when I got there, and you never passed through.

Also, you're now retconning your route to add "I stayed in lower engine to work on my task," which wasn't in your original timeline. That's a red flag.

Meanwhile, Frank's route is corroborated by Bob in medbay, and Bob's later movements are corroborated by Alice. Frank has witnesses. You don't, and your story keeps shifting.

I'm voting Eve.

I've already shared my full route and analysis, but to reinforce: Frank's story is corroborated by my direct observation of him in medbay at ticks 3-5, and his entry from storage at tick 3 matches exactly. Eve's route, on the other hand, has been contradicted by Charlie in BOTH storage and lower engine — and her response was to retcon "I stayed in lower engine for my task," which wasn't in her original timeline.

Eve also tried to deflect by pointing to a minor wording difference between me and Alice about who saw whom at weapons — but Alice and I are clearly each other's alibis at tick 10, regardless of phrasing. That's not a real contradiction, it's a distraction.

The evidence points to Eve. Voting Eve.
